question: Across reporting economies from 2000 to 2019, does faster real PPP GDP per capita growth mark a materially larger gain in life expectancy after comparing places in the same region with similar starting longevity and income?
decision: A reader monitoring development must decide whether to treat GDP growth as evidence of health progress or keep a separate health series. A growth-linked account predicts a positive conditional gradient. A starting-position/catch-up account predicts little remaining gradient once baseline health, affluence and regional differences in average gains are held fixed. These accounts can coexist; the contrast tests the incremental association, not a causal effect. A growth association with HDI alone would not settle the issue, since HDI includes income.
design: One observation per ISO3 with finite life expectancy and positive PPP GDP per capita at both endpoints and a reported region. No interpolation, population weighting or selection on schooling or HDI in the primary analysis. Stop at 2019 to avoid measuring COVID-period mortality shocks. Use natural log GDP ratio divided by ln(1.5), so a unit is a factor of 1.5 in cumulative growth factors; outcome is endpoint minus starting life expectancy in years. OLS with intercept, accounting first for nothing else, then for region indicators, starting life expectancy in years and starting log GDP. Weight economies equally. Report the partial R-squared of growth conditional on the other terms, on an identical sample. Estimate conventional descriptive model uncertainty with heteroskedasticity-consistent HC3 standard errors and normal 95% limits. If any region is a singleton, absorb its mean and exclude singleton rows from slope inference (the same rows throughout each comparison); disclose losses. Do not trim valid extreme values.
evaluation: Primary substantive benchmark is +0.5 life-years per 1.5-fold higher GDP growth factor, a declared six-month reporting threshold, not an estimated biological minimum. Compare the full 95% interval with this threshold: lower limit above it supports a material positive marker; upper limit below it rules out a gradient that large under the working model; an interval crossing it leaves materiality unresolved. Separately distinguish a positive association (interval above zero), a negative one, and lack of directional resolution. Neither attenuation nor a non-significant estimate establishes the rival mechanism.
sensitivity: On the primary sample add squared centered starting longevity and log GDP to relax the linear catch-up assumption. Refit the primary model omitting each region in turn. Refit on complete 2000–2015 endpoints (shorter horizon; not an independent test). On the common 2000–2019 sample also reporting HDI at both ends, fit matched life-expectancy and HDI-change regressions on the same primary RHS; interpret the HDI slope only as a composite-index comparator, not in life-years or proof of income's mechanical contribution. Report counts and region coverage including absent observations. Stop after these specified checks unless a coding error requires correction.
data_already_inspected: This is a new delivery on existing inputs, not a blinded replication. Prior to this freeze this analyst read the supplied direction, assignment, accompanying source notes and literature excerpts and the CSV header only. No country values, outcome summaries, previous attempts' work/results or evaluation materials were consulted. No external scientific inputs.
budget: Single offline analysis of the supplied vintage using Python and NumPy only. No tuning or outcome-dependent sampling. Re-run byte checks in an empty output directory; a replay tests computation, not independent evidence.

criteria.description: Report adjusted growth gradient, robust uncertainty and evaluation against the six-month benchmark. Indicator lower_above_benchmark equals one when the lower confidence limit exceeds 0.5 years.
Compare the unadjusted gradient on the same economies with incremental explanatory power after adjustment.
Report baseline curvature, shorter endpoint and one-region-deleted analyses.
Compare health and composite-index associations on identical economies with both measures.
